name: Summoned shut-in who resets on death
details: Japanese teen shut-in in a tracksuit dropped into a fantasy capital; dies, loops back in time, and schemes to save the people he cares about.

name: Lazy adventurer stuck with a useless party
details: Japanese gamer in a green cape and tunic; uses cheap tricks and a stealing skill to drag his chaotic party through one more paid quest.

name: Reincarnated as a monster who builds a nation
details: Japanese office worker reborn as a blue blob that copies skills; befriends monsters and settles their disputes as their easygoing ruler.

name: Gamer trapped as his own undead raid boss
details: Japanese salaryman stuck as his skeletal dread-lord avatar in black robes; bluffs majesty to servants who think every blunder is a master plan.

name: Reborn as a prodigy child mage
details: Japanese shut-in reborn as a country noble's son; in a robe with a staff, studies magic hard and tries to live this second life properly.

name: Betrayed hero stuck with only a shield
details: Japanese college otaku summoned as a hero with nothing but a shield; framed by the court, he grinds, trades and protects his small party.

name: Reincarnated as a tiny dungeon spider
details: Japanese student reborn as a spider at the bottom of a monster dungeon; levels up fight by fight, narrating every panic in a running monologue.

name: Reincarnated as a talking magic sword
details: Japanese man reborn as an intelligent sword; chosen by a young adventurer, he guides her fights from the scabbard and fusses like a parent.

name: Reborn as a dungeon vending machine
details: Japanese vending-machine fan reborn as one in a dungeon; can only say stock phrases, yet helps adventurers by choosing what to dispense.

name: Black-coated swordsman trapped in a game
details: Japanese teen gamer in a long black coat with twin swords, trapped in a deadly virtual world; clears floors solo to free the other players.

name: Strategist in a game world gone real
details: Bespectacled Japanese grad student in an enchanter's white robe; plans guild politics and turns the old game rules into a working society.

name: Abandoned weakling turned gunslinger
details: Japanese student summoned with his class and left in an abyss; climbs back white-haired with an eyepatch, revolvers and a cold, practical streak.

name: Earnest rookie dungeon adventurer
details: White-haired rookie in light armor with a knife; dives the dungeon daily to grow strong enough to stand beside the swordswoman he admires.

name: Overpowered grandson of a legendary sage
details: Japanese man reborn and raised by a hermit sage; enrolls at a magic academy in a plain robe and casually breaks every record by accident.

name: Wannabe shadow mastermind
details: Japanese teen reborn as a noble's son; in a black hooded longcoat he plays secret mastermind, never noticing his made-up plots are real.

name: Monster-obsessed dungeon cook
details: Tall adventurer in a blue tunic and armor; crawls the dungeon to rescue his sister, cooking and eating every monster on the way down.

name: Magicless orphan who wants to be the top mage
details: Spiky-haired farm orphan in a black hooded robe with an anti-magic sword; outworks everyone in a kingdom where everybody else has magic.

name: Chef whose door opens to a fantasy world
details: Japanese restaurant owner in a white chef's coat; once a week his door opens onto a fantasy realm and he feeds whoever walks in.

name: Isekai'd teen whose phone still works
details: Japanese teen reborn by an apologetic god with his smartphone; in a white coat, uses it and boundless magic to politely fix every problem.

name: Summoned hero banished for being plain
details: Japanese student a goddess calls too ugly and dumps in the wasteland; in a hooded robe, quietly builds a merchant company staffed by monsters.

name: Reincarnated farmer with a divine hoe
details: Japanese salaryman reborn in the wilds with an all-purpose farm tool; in work clothes, builds a village as elves and dragons move in.

name: Summoned cook with an online grocery skill
details: Japanese salaryman summoned by mistake; his only skill orders groceries from home, and his cooking wins over a legendary wolf familiar.

name: Witch who doesn't know she's the strongest
details: Young witch in a wide hat and cloak who thinks she's mediocre; takes small village jobs and casually flattens monsters along the way.

name: Ageless elf mage retracing an old journey
details: Elf mage in a white-and-gold coat; centuries old, retraces her late party's route, collecting odd spells and slowly learning about people.

name: Apprentice who saw how magic is drawn
details: Tailor's daughter in an apprentice's pointed hat and cape; learns spells are drawn in ink and tries to undo one she cast by mistake.

name: Bookworm reborn as a sickly poor girl
details: Book lover reborn as a frail commoner girl in a world without cheap books; invents paper and printing so she can read again.

name: Reincarnated villainess dodging her doom
details: Noble girl who remembers this world is a dating game where she's the villain; in a frilly gown, farms and befriends everyone to dodge bad endings.

name: Sheltered princess who takes up the bow
details: Red-haired princess driven from her palace by a coup; in a travel cloak with a bow, gathers legendary warriors and sees her people's hardship.

name: Ruthless child officer in a magic war
details: Small girl in a military greatcoat with a rifle; a reborn cynic who wants a safe desk job but keeps winning battles and getting promoted.

name: Traveling witch who visits a new land each time
details: Young witch in a black hat and robe on a broom; lands in a strange country each episode, observes its quirks, and leaves a little wiser.

name: Summoned saint who'd rather brew potions
details: Office worker summoned as a saint, then overlooked; in a lab coat over a gown, brews too-strong potions and cooks for the knights.

name: Defense-maxed gamer girl in black armor
details: Cheerful newcomer to a VR game who put every point into defense; in heavy black armor, absorbs attacks and turns them into absurd powers.

name: Immortal witch who maxed out by accident
details: Reborn office worker living as a quiet highland witch; centuries of killing slimes daily made her the strongest, and trouble comes knocking.

name: Palace herbalist who won't be anyone's prize
details: Red-haired herbalist in a court apothecary's coat; flees a prince who wants her as a trophy and earns her own place at a neighbouring palace.

name: Reborn girl hiding her too-strong powers
details: Girl who asked for average powers and got huge ones; in an adventurer's tunic, keeps trying to look normal on her party's quests.

name: Executed princess replaying her life carefully
details: Selfish princess sent back in time after her execution; in ballgowns, scrambles to save the empire and is praised as a genius by mistake.

name: Clumsy witch student with big dreams
details: Girl from a non-magic family in a witch academy's hat and uniform; fails spells loudly but never stops chasing her idol's showy magic.

name: Half-demon swordswoman hunting monsters
details: Silver-eyed warrior in pale armor with a huge sword; hunts demons village to village while chasing the one that ruined her life.

name: Commoner girl openly courting her noble rival
details: Commoner student at a noble academy in a plain uniform; cheerfully, relentlessly woos the haughty young lady who torments her.

name: Inventor princess who falls for her lady-in-waiting
details: Eccentric princess in a work coat over her dress, building flying brooms; takes in a disgraced noble lady as her aide and falls for her.

name: Explorer of an eerie otherworld with her partner
details: College student in hiking gear crossing into a haunted other world; hunts its monsters for cash beside the woman she's slowly falling for.

name: Executioner who can't strike her summoned target
details: Priestess-executioner in a white habit who hunts summoned heroes; traveling with her latest target, she keeps finding reasons not to strike.

name: Necromancer reborn beside the swordsman who loves him
details: Disgraced flute-playing necromancer back in a stranger's body; in dark robes, solves ghost cases beside a stoic swordsman who loves him.

name: Luckless fallen god courted by a demon king
details: Former crown prince turned scrap-collecting god in white robes; answers small prayers and odd cases, shadowed by the demon king who adores him.

name: Girl who wants to be a prince, dueling for a bride
details: Bold student in a school jacket who dreams of being a prince; wins sword duels for a mysterious bride and resolves to protect her.

name: Dark-skinned seafarer who conquers dungeons
details: Dark-skinned young sailor in sea-traveler's wraps with a djinn-bound sword; conquers dungeons to found a nation for the displaced.

name: Sunny dark-skinned heir from a desert land
details: Cheerful dark-skinned heir in gold-trimmed robes at a magic school; throws feasts and trusts too easily, leaving his retainer scrambling.

name: Dark-skinned ronin guarding a gifted child
details: Weary dark-skinned ronin boatman with a long sword; protects a young girl with strange powers from warlords and sorcerers.

name: Last of a hunted wolf-shifter clan
details: Wolf-shifter youth in a dark coat with a staff; hunts vampires with a ragtag crew while searching for his scattered people.

name: Lizardfolk warrior defending his marsh
details: Scaled lizardfolk warrior with a frost-bladed sword; unites rival marsh tribes against an undead army they cannot beat.

name: Dog-eared half-demon scorned by both sides
details: Silver-haired half-demon with dog ears in a red fire-rat robe; hunts jewel shards with a reluctant team, scorned by humans and demons alike.

name: Reptile-headed amnesiac hunting his curser
details: Lizard-headed man in work coveralls who forgot his old face; bites sorcerers to find which one cursed him, then shares dumplings.

name: Forest golem raising a lost human child
details: Mossy golem in a traveling cloak guarding a human child disguised as beastfolk; crosses a world of creatures to find her kin.

name: Living shadow from a persecuted clan
details: Small living shadow from a hunted clan, wrapped in a borrowed cloak; befriends an outcast prince and steals, scouts and fights for him.

name: Demon king's son training as an exorcist
details: Hot-headed teen with a hidden tail and blue flames, son of a demon king; trains at an exorcist school to prove he's no monster.
